keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search terms (max 25). With compare on, each group of up to 5 is fetched together so values are on one shared 0-100 scale.

geo.title: Location
geo.description: Country or region code, e.g. `US`, `GB`, `US-IA`. Empty = worldwide.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Window: 1h, 4h, 1d, 7d, 30d, 90d, 12m (default), 5y, all (2004-). Custom: "YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD" via API.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: What to fetch: `timeline` (interest over time + summary), `regions` (interest by region), `related` (related queries and topics, top and rising). Fewer sections = faster.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: `full` includes every timeline point; `summary` drops the points and keeps latest/peak/average/changePct/trend to save tokens. Same price.

compare.title: Compare keywords
compare.description: On: keywords share one 0-100 scale (Google's comparison mode, groups of 5). Off: each keyword is scaled on its own.

property.title: Search property
property.description: Which Google search to measure. Default web.

category.title: Category ID
category.description: Google Trends category ID (0 = all categories).

maxRegions.title: Max regions
maxRegions.description: Top regions to return per keyword. Default 15.

maxRelated.title: Max related items
maxRelated.description: Items per related list (top and rising, queries and topics). Default 10.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for region and topic names, e.g. en-US, de.
